newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mavesa started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mavesa started as hold.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais said it started coverage of Venezuela's Mavesa SA with a rating of hold.

-- Shares in the food manufacturer "stand at premiums of 41 percent and 20 percent to the Venezuelan market and the Latin Aemrican food sector average" respectively, analyst Dana Voelzke wrote in a Friday report.
-- "We view these premiums as justified given Mavesa's high operating margins and leading market position in Venezuela.

-- "However, considering the price rise of more than 150 percent in U.S. dollar terms year-to-date, and flat EBITDA growth over the next three years, we see little upside in the shares from current levels ...," he wrote.
-- The company's shares were trading at 134, down three, in Caracas.
